_readme: Skins for the Skin Gallery (skin_test_study.html) and the Terrain Walk. Drop a .glb/.gltf or a Mixamo .fbx (T-pose, With Skin) here and add a line to skins[]; the studies list every entry and LOAD IT ONLY WHEN PICKED (some are 60 MB). Bone names must be Mixamo's (mixamorig:*). Xbot.glb is the standing right-side reference and is loaded separately. 2026-09-02 CULL (Doug): 5 entries removed - every one audited in the running page against the stage's own rule (adoptGltf fails unless all 7 mixamorig leg bones are present). 11 of 16 passed. REMOVED, and WHY, so nobody re-adds them blindly: Ch19_nonPBR.fbx - rig is COMPLETE but its bones are named mixamorig1* (Mixamo appends a digit on re-rig) and normalizeBones() only strips 'mixamorig:'; widening it to /^mixamorig\d*/ would likely recover this skin outright. character.fbx - three r160 cannot open it at all: 'FBX version not supported, FileVersion: 6100'; needs a re-export from source. boy_static.glb / charlotte_static.glb / wanderer_static.glb - Meshy exports, 0 bones, already flagged rig:false; they were never going to walk. All five FILES REMAIN ON DISK - only the manifest lines are gone. 2026-09-02 RENAMES (Doug): Ch14->Mouse, Ch34->Elf Girl, Ch46->Young Girl, Character 2 (character_1.fbx)->Creepy Mummy. Ch19 and Character 1 confirmed removed in the earlier cull.

props.name: Gold dragon (Meshy text-to-3D from the title poster look, 2026-09-02)
props._note: Static mesh, no skeleton (Meshy rigging + animation library are biped-only; the rig attempt on the poster-crop model was rejected: 'Pose estimation failed'). Three whole-object clips were hand-authored into the GLB on a wrapper node DragonRoot: hover (3 s bob), turntable (8 s yaw), pounce (2.4 s crouch-lunge, +Z forward). Untouched Meshy export: dragon_meshy_static.glb (gitignored). Meshy tasks: preview 01a06554-9902-7157-acf5-c3f96944eec4, refine 01a06556-0199-720d-ac1f-9da026497346.

props.name: Gold dragon, LOW-POLY trial (Meshy remesh of the same refine task, 2026-09-04)
props._note: LOW-POLY-DEFAULT TRIAL, Doug approved the credits. Meshy remesh task 01a06d97-3792-77e0-ae3f-4feb15f31069, input_task_id 01a06556-0199-720d-ac1f-9da026497346 (the original refine), topology triangle, target_polycount 15000. Cost 5 credits; balance 2484 -> 2479. RESULT: 70,820 -> 15,603 tris (22%), surface area and volume both 99.6% of the original, mean surface deviation 0.009% of the model diagonal. TWO THINGS THE REMESH DOES NOT DO, both handled here and both needed by any low-poly pipeline: (1) it returns PNG textures at 2048 base colour and 4096 metallic-roughness, so the raw output is 15.5 MB - BIGGER than the 8.04 MB original; re-encoded to 1024/512 JPEG here, after dilating the UV gutter, which Meshy leaves pure black and which would otherwise bleed dark seams along every UV edge when downscaled. (2) it drops animations; the three hand-authored DragonRoot clips (hover, turntable, pounce) were re-applied from dragon_meshy.glb. Final 0.96 MB, 12% of the original download. Untouched Meshy output kept locally as dragon_lowpoly_raw.glb (gitignored, 15.5 MB) so other texture budgets can be derived without spending credits again.

props.name: Small campfire (Meshy text-to-3D feasibility test, 2026-09-02)

Usable as a stylized prop only. Real fire (small fire, embers, blazing campfire, hearth, dragon breath) should be three.js particle/shader VFX in the engine.
